method: Human engineering review of each rendered unit against only its registered source keys and cited canonical chunks. No retrieval, generation, web evidence or model judgement was used.

factual.detail: Literal figures match their sources, but missing application scopes make three propositions technically over-general and one source-defined rock-condition set is under-specified.

citation.detail: Coverage is 100%, but SRC-DOC000087-e7393bf8138a renders an unrelated heading ('Tokluk İndeksi - Enerji Depolama Kapasitesi') for cement-dose claims; allocation to that key is misleading even though the chunk later contains the supporting clause.

language.detail: All visible units are Turkish. Terminology and sentence quality are inconsistent: katman/tabaka, durabilite, ön dizayn and a duplicated sınıf construction reduce book quality.

condition.detail: Frozen validator conditions score 100%, but the claim set omits wet-system and repair-work scopes and does not retain the named rock classes; validator success therefore does not establish engineering scope completeness.

qualifier.detail: Both registered qualifiers are present. C-002's qualifier surface has an ambiguous subject and can be read as calling the C25/30 class itself an acceptance criterion.

findings.source_location: DOC000087-C0279, under §351.08.10 Kaya Destekleme İçin Kullanılan Yaş Sistem Püskürtme Betonun Uygulanması
findings.finding: The 60/100 mm first-layer guidance and 50-200 mm following-layer range are wet-system application guidance, but both claims declare system_independent and the draft presents them generally.
findings.required_remediation: Create a new versioned claim/scope artifact carrying the wet-system scope and allocate the claims under an explicit wet-system context.

findings.source_location: DOC000087-C0281, §351.08.11 Tamir İşleri için Püskürtmenin Uygulanması
findings.finding: The approximate 3-5 hour waiting time is stated in the repair-work section, but the claim declares system_independent and the draft generalizes it to subsequent layers.
findings.required_remediation: Carry repair-work scope as a mandatory condition or remove the optional claim from this section allocation.

findings.source_location: DOC000047-C0206, Table 9-2 rows for crushed, squeezing and swelling rock
findings.finding: The source names the applicable rock conditions, while the draft says only 'belirli kaya koşullarında'. The registered conditions omit the named classes, so validation cannot require them.
findings.required_remediation: Version the condition/gloss representation so the named source classes and tunnel-size dependency are deterministically realized.

findings.finding: The dosage discussion states the 350/400 kg/m³ minima but omits the same cited source's 500 kg/m³ maximum and the instruction to reconsider cement type if required properties cannot be achieved within it.
findings.required_remediation: Add a source-backed, separately auditable maximum-dose claim and allocate it adjacent to the minima.

findings.source_location: source registry section_path and rendered reference 4
findings.finding: The registered source key resolves to the unrelated heading 'Tokluk İndeksi - Enerji Depolama Kapasitesi', producing a misleading bibliography entry for cement requirements.
findings.required_remediation: Use a correctly sectioned, versioned source key or allocate only the independently supporting DOC000236 cement source; do not mutate the frozen registry.

findings.finding: The qualifier sentence has C25/30 dayanım sınıfı as grammatical subject and then calls it quality-control criteria, although the 22.5/25.5 MPa core results are the acceptance criteria for that class.
findings.required_remediation: Version the deterministic realization so the table values, not the strength-class designation, are unambiguously the criterion subject.

findings.finding: The source-derived phrase 'minimum C25/30 MPa sınıfında' redundantly attaches MPa to a class designation and repeats sınıf; it is faithful but technically inelegant.
findings.required_remediation: Represent the class designation and its MPa meaning in a deterministic, source-faithful technical form.

findings.finding: The wet-system minimum is stated and then immediately repeated in a summary claim, while the dry-system minimum is also repeated; this consumes prose without adding engineering content.
findings.required_remediation: Choose either the atomic pair or the summary allocation, while retaining the exception and maximum-dose boundary.

pilot_prose_issues: The title is only the section identifier and there are no descriptive subsection headings.
Nineteen material units are distributed as short isolated paragraphs with no visible technical hierarchy.
'Özel uygulamalar dışında.' is an orphan sentence fragment rather than a locally bound condition.
Label-like openings ('Kuru Sistem:', 'Yaş Sistem:', 'Çevresel Şartlar:') imitate notes rather than finished reference-book prose.
The 'Özetle' sentence repeats the preceding dose requirements.
Terminology alternates between katman and tabaka without a declared distinction.
The qualifier for Table 351-5 is grammatically ambiguous.
Citation placement is safe but visually repetitive where adjacent units share the same source.
